title: Canvas surfaces
description: The app's Skia canvas surfaces, read by the skia-canvas-rendering checkers. Optional: without it, every src/features/<feature>/canvas and src/games/<game-id>/canvas folder is a timeline surface (live with a sim/ sibling), each is opaque, the palette sets are light and dark, and no canvas outside a surface folder may draw a computed picture.

paletteSets.description: The palette sets every canvas-palettes.json holds, with identical tokens. light and dark always; add colorBlindLight/colorBlindDark or highContrast sets when the app offers that setting.

goldensDir.description: Where the surface pixel goldens live (default test/goldens/canvas).

dir.description: Repo-relative folder holding the surface files (one surface per folder).

kind.description: timeline (default): committed changes played by the scene clock. live: a real-time loop draws every frame (realtime-game-loop owns its draw test and goldens); here it needs palettes, contrast pairs and a draw file only.

opaque.description: true (default): draw() paints every pixel first (canvas.drawColor of the background) and the canvas is rendered opaque (on Android a SurfaceView). false: the canvas shows what lies behind it; every SurfaceHost/SurfaceCanvas that renders it passes isOpaque={false} (on Android a TextureView, which costs more), which check-canvas-code proves (opaque-contract).

staticCanvases.description: App source files outside every surface folder whose <Canvas> shows static art recorded once (createPicture, a fixed Picture). Exempt from canvas-outside-surface; a listed file that reads per-frame values still fails. A static declarative canvas (a gradient, a blur, fixed shapes) needs no entry.
